daily.today_energy: Mercury's dancing through your sector of connections, Libra. You're giving off main character energy today—people are drawn to your authenticity. Trust the vibe shifts happening around you; they're steering you toward something real.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, your heart's speaking a clearer language today. If you've been sitting on feelings, the universe is lowkey pushing you to express them. Vulnerability looks good on you right now.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. Don't sleep on that thought that just popped into your head—it's worth exploring. Your collaborative energy is at peak levels; this is your moment to pitch, suggest, or build something with others.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not forced. A walk, some stretching, or dancing to your favorite song will shift your whole mood. Listen to what brings you ease today rather than chasing intensity.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to embrace your natural magnetism, Libra. Venus is whispering about authenticity over perfection, so lean into what feels genuinely you. Trust the timing of things unfolding.
weekly.love: Someone's been noticing your vibe lately. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or attracting fresh energy, this is a moment to be honest about what you actually want instead of what looks good.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different right now. Don't hold back in meetings or creative spaces. The universe is rewarding bold moves and unexpected contributions, so speak up even if it feels unconventional.
weekly.health: Your nervous system is asking for rest disguised as fun. Find activities that feel nourishing rather than draining—think less hustle culture, more intentional downtime. Movement and stillness in balance.
